segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, while waiting for the presentation of the DOH, may we first acknowledge the chairman of the Committee on Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: May we recognize Chair Gato for his manifestation habang iniintay po natin yung presentation ng DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, esteemed colleagues, Secretary Edwin Mercado and family, DOH family. Magandang umaga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Sabi nila, walang kinikilalang yaman o estado sa buhay ang sakit. Illnesses do not discriminate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Yes, they do. Because while a disease like cancer may afflict anyone, it does not affect everyone equally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: The difference is often not in the disease itself, but in what comes after the diagnosis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Who can begin treatment immediately, who has to wait, who can sustain years of care, and who is forced into debt simply to keep going.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: And sometimes, the difference is simply who gets to survive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: This is the reality that the Department of Health

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: continues to confront, while carrying the enormous responsibility of protecting the health and well-being of more than 100 million Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: The challenges before the DOH are immense and constantly evolving.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Yet, it continues to strengthen primary and public health care, expand access to essential medicines and life-saving interventions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: advance universal health care, strengthen local health services,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: support our healthcare workers, and protect our communities through prevention and health promotion, like immunization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Mr. Chair, as Chair of the Department of Health, as Chair of the Committee on Health, the House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: may I express my full and unequivocal support for the proposed budget of the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Bung puso po natin sinusuportahan ang panukalang budget ng Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Because health is a right and not a privilege, at ang karapatan nito ay hindi dapat nakadepende sa kakayahan magbayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: No Filipino should have to delay treatment because they cannot afford it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: No family should have to choose between continuing a course of treatment and meeting their most basic needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: And no one should be left behind simply because the care they need is beyond their means.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Our budget must reflect this principle. Mr. Chair, my dear colleagues, let us give the DOH the capacity to respond, our healthcare workers the support they deserve, and our communities the services they need.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., M.D., FPSO-HNS
segments.text: Let us approve a health budget that is not merely adequate, but responsive to the realities of our people, equitable in its reach, and worthy of the right to health that we have pledged to uphold. Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair. Mabuhay ang healthcare workers. Mabuhay ang Department of Health. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Chair Siriaco Gato, Committee on Health, for your manifestation of support to the budget of the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, I see that the presentation is now flashed on the screen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, I would like to recognize once again.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, once again, our Secretary of Health, Dr. Edwin Mercado, for your presentation.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Rep. Kong Abet Garcia.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At muli po, magandang umaga po sa lahat po ng ating members ng Appropriations Committee.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po yung ating presentation on the 2027 National Healthcare Expenditure.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, ang ating pong vision is to make the Filipinos among the best.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: The healthiest people in Asia by 2014.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, that means also making sure that they have access to quality healthcare.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And as Kong Gato mentioned earlier, financial risk protection.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, ang ating pong hangad ay talagang yung pagpapalatag po ng ating universal healthcare program, which I will expound on later.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, nung ako po ay natalaga bilang kaliin po ng kalusugan.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Three weeks ago, nag-draft na po kami ng Unified Health Agenda,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ang katawagin po namin ay UNA, with PCO Bev Ho.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: For the first time po, nagkaroon ng common agenda po ang DOH at PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At pinagkabit po namin yung mga programa ng PhilHealth na dapat pong bigyan din ng suporta ng DOH and vice versa po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mga programa rin ng DOH na kailangan pong suportahan ng ating PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang stronger alignment is along four or five major pillars.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang una po dyan ay yung healthy schools, workplace, and communities, which will be focusing on prevention, health promotion, early screening, and linking to PhilHealth benefits like the YACAP and the gamot.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, i-embed na rin po namin dyan yung ating pong mga health programs para po at the level of the settings na kung saan po natin imimit mismo yung ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang all-in-one po na approach itong ating primary health care.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, ang pangalawa nga po, patungo dun sa primary health care, ay tiyakin din pong merong access sa mga doktor, sa mga gamot, at sa mga procedures na at least essential procedures po na i-cover natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya, gaya po, at didiscuss naman po ito ng PCO Bev, palalawakin po yung coverage ng ating YACAP sa kasalukuyang labing dalawa, labing tatlong lab test tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung pangatatlo po ay equality and efficient hospital.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, ako po ay mag-create ng hospital operations cluster.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi almost 40% po ng budget ng DOH are on hospital operations.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, yun po yung pinakamalaking cost component ng aming budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya, kailangan din po natin siguruduhin na efficient yung pagde-deliver ng ating mga hospital.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At yun naman po yung aking, kung tawagin, 40.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi ito po ang aking ginawa nung ako po ay nasa private sector pa lang.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang pang-apat po ay yung information technology transformation.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So easier access and front-facing of our patients.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung ano po, ito po rin yung ating pagkukuna ng datos para po yung ating mga health programs ay mas maging data-driven evidence-based.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ang pang-lima po ay strong institution and health workforce, particularly to address the persistent health workforce issues.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So the end goal po is to move UHC from policy to practice and to ensure that its benefits are actually experienced by every Filipino.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So we will be more proactive in reaching out to our, at hindi po yung hinihintay pang sila ay magkasakit para pumasok dito sa ating healthcare system.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So gaya po ng nabanggit ni Kong Abet, ang kabuan po ng aming budget ay 353.8 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Based po on our approved NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At along our five pillars, dinistribute po namin itong ating budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ito po yung pakikita ko mamaya kung bakit po ganito ang aming distribution at ano po yung mga programang ating gagawin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So sa kabuan po in the current administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ay 1.97 trillion na po ang talagang nailaan.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ay significant dahil sa unang pagkakataon ho, yung ating healthcare expenditure or current healthcare expenditure noong 2025.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Base po doon sa ating Philippine Statistics Authority.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yun po yung unang pagkakataon na yung ating government spending ay humigit kaysa doon sa out-of-pocket spending.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang may isa lang pong one-off noong COVID.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi marami talaga pong naglagay tayo, naglaan.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang ating government spending ay humigit kaysa doon sa out-of-pocket spending.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero ngayon po on regular basis, ang healthcare expenditure of government increased from 42.1% in 2023 to current 46.5% in 2025.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Such that the out-of-pocket spending of the Filipinos were brought down from 44.4% to 41.2%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito'y pagpapatunay pong kumakapit na po yung mga programa natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And NEP, ay gaya ng nabanggit ni Kong Abet, ay 4.9, ay mas mababa po ng 21.2% compared to 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Bagamat ito po ay 10% higher noong 2026 NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero sa kabuan po, ito ay nagkoconstitute po ng 4.9% of our 7.2 trillion national budget and 1.1% of the projected 2027 GDP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung tutusin po, medyo mababa pa rin po kasi ang usual po na GDP health to GDP ratio po is nasa 8 to 10%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So tayo po ay, although ito po ay spending lang ng government, if you say that government is spending 46%, assuming 1%,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: kung inidagdag po natin yung private spending, abot pa rin po ng mga 2.53%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Medyo mababa po compared dun sa talaga pong dapat na ibigay for healthcare.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: National priority and investment in terms of human capital.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So gaya ng nasabi ko po, ang pinakamalaking component po nitong ating budget ay sa maintenance and other operating expense.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nakasama naman po dito sa MOOE, yung iba pong mga subscription for managed services, etc.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya nga po gaya ng nasabi ko, bulk of this will be coming from hospital operations.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: That's why I want to really make sure that this is properly used.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang personal service po ay tumaas ng 77% to 117 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay dahil dun sa full implementation na po ng ating salary standardization law.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nasa huling yugtunan po tayo dun sa implementation ng SSL.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung capital outlay po yung medyo malaki po yung nabawas, kumpara nun 2026.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At karamihan pa po dito sa 19, or hindi naman karamihan, may portion po dito sa 19 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Almost 4.2 billion po ay nakalaan na po para dun sa Health System Resilience Project

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: na tayo po ay merong World Bank loan na na-approve po nung 2025.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At yun nga po, pinupush na naming magamit.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay nakalaan sa 17 probinsya po, ayon po dun sa ating naging loan agreement with the World Bank.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung iba naman po ay HVEP, 14.5 billion, which includes the facilities, infrastructures, and the equipment.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So nais ko lang po ngayong himayin yung mga programa po natin kada pilar.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ang unang pilar na Healthy Schools, Workplace, and Communities.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Karamihan po dyan ay yung mga syntax revenue for the payment of the indirect contributors of PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ay sumasaklaw sa 19.3 indirect contributors, 55.4.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero kung tutuusin po natin yung gastusin ng PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: para po i-cover yung benefit expense nitong ating mga indirect members, medyo po kulang po yung 55.4 million.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa kasulukuyan po, ipapaliwanag naman ni PCEO Bevian, pero sumisipa na po yung indirect members

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: kasi meron na po silang consciousness na sila pala ay merong beneficio at immediate eligibility.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So nakikita po talaga namin nag-avail na.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung 2.5 billion po ay for health promotion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kakabit na natin dun sa setting-based impanelment ng YACAP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Itong kasabay na yung health promotion, lalong-lalo na po dun sa ating mga schools

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: para po maturuan na kaagad natin yung ating mga kabataan, ano po yung tamang mga habits to be healthy.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At yung 1.3 billion po ay sa health emergency preparedness, response, quarantine service, and international health surveillance.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Di po lingid sa atin, meron po tayong problema ngayon ng HACE dahil po cross-boundary na po ang issue.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pati po yung mga emerging diseases like Ebola, yun po yung transfer.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: na po o zoonotic disease na nagmumula sa mga hayop, lumilipat na po sa mga tao.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay sanhinan ng ating global warming, kaya po talagang dapat paglaanan at pagpagpreparahan ito po ang ating response na ito.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ang bunga ng ating focus sa ating primary care system.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Two out of three children are fully immunized, although ito po ay mababa pa dun sa ating target na 95%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po talaga ipupush natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung eight out of ten children aged two years old and below with adequate height and age, ito po yung stunting,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Bagumat yun po ay malayo pa rin po dun sa ating mga target.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Lalo na po dun sa millennium development goal targets natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung pong household na may access sa basic water supply ay nasa 82.74%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung pong mga Pilipinong pamilya na meron pong access sa modern family planning methods ay nasa 64.5%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ang may TB po, meron naman po tayong 85%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Na yun po ang ating target na accomplished po natin na yung pong nadadiagnose ng TB ay nabibigyan ng gamot.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ito pong ating Pilipino na living with HIV, medyo malayo pa rin dun sa ating target na 95% kasi ngayon po ay nasa 66% pa rin po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero meron na po kaming ginagawang mga programa na palialawigin po yung OHAT program ng PhilHealth

segments.text: At yung testing po palalawigin din natin para po maitaas natin dun sa ating target na 95%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At dun naman po sa mental health ay 262,000 po ang ating individual na nakakuha po ng gamot for mental health.

segments.text: Kasama po din dito sa ating first, second pillar na functional primary care,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: yung ating pong family health, immunization, nutrition, and responsible care.

segments.text: At yung ating parenting, which is pegged at 9.1 billion.

segments.text: At ito po ay tatargetin po natin yung mga vulnerable population.

segments.text: Gaya po ng mga senior citizen, mga may edad na, mga bata, at yung po meron ng pre-existing disease.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ganon din po sa communicable disease prevention, which includes TB and HIV, 6.9 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa non-communicable disease, ito naman po yung mga emerging diseases due to modern living,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At dito po sa local health system development, dahil gusto nga natin, because of our devolved nature,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: talaga pong matulungan yung local government units na palakasin yung kanilang local health system,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ay may nakalaan po tayong 1.5 billion, which will cover 110 UHC integration sites.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasama pa rin po dito sa ating next pillar ay yung ating pong mga functional primary care,

segments.text: system, nakikita po dito na ang ating pong benefit payment noong 2025 sa PhilHealth ay umabot po ng higit 300 billion.

segments.text: Salamat po at tanagaabang ating mga key population.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pag-usapan po natin yung supply and chain management kasi nababalitaan po namin ang daming failure sa ating logistics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Bakit po sa ating NEP pare-parehong 10 million na allocation para sa lahat ng regions para ting sa supply and chain management?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: 10 million sa NCR, 10 million sa Central Visayas, 10 million sa Caraga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Character of these regions, sigurado po tayo hindi pare-pareho yung requirements when it comes to logistics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ano pong science behind this 10 million allocation across all regions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Okay, that will be the last question.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nakita ko rin po yun bakit pare-pareho.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Iba-iba naman yung site, yung geographic layout nung kada region.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero ang sabi po ay dahil sa warehousing which is common daw for all the regions.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero gaya po nang nasabi ko.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nag-aaralan din namin po paano nga po ito maging mas efficient.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ano po yung variability factors na kailangan po nating i-consider.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: E nababother po kasi tayo sa mga ganyang klase na allocation kasi sigurado po tayo hindi yan batay doon sa evidence at pangangailangan ng region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat DML Sendanya for your very valuable and significant questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: We now move to the majority. May I recognize Representative Adrian.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Thank you very much Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Good morning po sa buong DOH family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Gusto ko lang pong itanong kasi pag may nakakausap akong mga legislators sa ibang bansa lagi sila nagugulat sa healthcare system natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi meron tayong sa PhilHealth, meron tayong may yakap at saka ano-ano pang mga programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Bakit po hindi natin mapag-isa so that kung mga kasi minsan may mga programs tayo na hindi na nga maintindihan ng mga constituents natin eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Ako nga minsan may ibang hindi ko maintindihan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: So bakit po hindi nalang isang healthcare system, isang programa na kung saan malaki yung nakukuha ng mga constituents natin?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Tama po yan dahil sa pag-aaral nga po ng Philippine Institute of Developmental Studies.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kapag ang payment po ay siloed, may iba-ibang pinagkukunan. May PhilHealth, may galing po sa DOH, may galing po sa DSWD-IX.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Humihina po yung leverage ng atin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung ito po ay ang mandato ng mga laman po mag-cover at magbayad ay PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung ito po ay unti-unti nating ma-ecentralize, yung leverage po natin, halimbawa na magbago po yung payment natin to what you call prospective, parang pakyawan.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Inumpisahan na po namin, kaya po maaaring nabalitaan nyo may mga private hospital na po na naglalaanong kama nila sa NBB.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yun po kasi nagagamit na po namin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nagagamit na po namin yung ating purchasing leverage and purchasing power.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero ngayon po, pag siloed po ang payment, medyo mahina po yun.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya nga po, unti-unti na namin pinag-aaralan paano po i-consolidate under PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Obviously, nabanggit nyo pa, may mga studies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Can we work together so that we can come up with a solution so that we can consolidate everything and make it easy for our constituents?

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi kawawa, naguguluhan sila minsan eh. Tapos minsan ang tagal pang maningil.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi yung mga constituents ko, lagi silang nagtatanong, bayad kami ng bayad sa PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Pero pag na-hospital kami, konting-konti naman yung nakukuha namin sa PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: And I also agree na dapat hindi nakalodge ang mga politiko ang medical assistance kasi minsan napo-politika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: As much as we want that to happen, ang problema kasi, pag lumalapit sa amin yung constituents namin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kapiranggot lang yung sinasagot ng PhilHealth, eh syempre ipaglalaban namin na pwede rin naming matulungan.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Sir, in the last two years po, halos doble na po yung...

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: But we recognize, for certain cases,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: lalo na yung mga pasyente na mas malubha yung kondisyon,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: kulang pa rin yung bayad doon.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So meron pong parte ng pinag-aaralan namin sa benepisyo namin,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: yung tinatawag na DRG or may modifier po.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Ngayon po, kahit ikaw ay may high blood,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: 60 years old na kunwari, na mas maraming sakit,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: kung nagka-say dengue ka, same lang po yung bayad ng PhilHealth sa inyo

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: versus someone na very young and healthy.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Parang yun yung klarong-klaro na dapat medyo magkaiba po

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: or may adjustments po yung bayad.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So meron na pong pag-aaral na nangyayari doon.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And that is supposed to inform how we adjust the payments further.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Second, sir, is clearly we have to work with the public hospitals

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: whose 90% of bids should really be no balance billing.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And merong mechanism po yung mga public hospitals

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: to get additional budget from LGU as well as additional MAIFIP, etc.,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: for example, na dapat at the end of the day,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: nakaka-uwi yung pasyente na wala po siyang extra na binayad.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So I think those are clearly implementation challenges

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: that we have to work with on top of rates adjustment

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: that we'll have to work on.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: But we definitely agree with you, sir, na lalo na now that also the premium is higher,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: our members expect na mas malakas,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: kaya din naman talaga yung coverage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Na-appreciate ko po yung sagot nyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Ang problema ko lang po kasi,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: pag nakikita ng mga constituents natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: na example yung sa PhilHealth Board,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: pag nakita nila yung benefits na nakakuha ng mga members ng board,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos pag narinig nila na may surplus na, may savings na ang PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kaya kinuha daw ng national government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Eh, hindi naman kami natutulungan ng maayos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: That is something that is very, very hard to explain,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Lalo na pag pag-need na nila, pag na-hospital siya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos they end up begging from politicians for help.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kaya nga sa office namin, tinanggal namin yung,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Ang staff natin, pag nakita nangangailangan kayo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: I hate it when constituents go to politicians and need to beg.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Unfortunately, hindi lang natin kaya pondohan lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kaya nga po sana may mas maayos na sistema so that PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: they can fund as much as they can.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And then, definitely sir, we know that the hospital bill is partly made up of

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, alam din po namin sa lahat ng discussions with our legislators na

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: the PF is also a big challenge.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And so, Sec. Edwin has already started and we will continue

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: our discussions po with the professional societies.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Lalo na kung magbigyan natin ng PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: ano yung ways for the healthcare professionals to make their PFs din

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: a little bit more predictable, diba?

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Para hindi tayo lahat magkagulatan kung magkano yun.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And siguro lastly, sir, we also recognize na

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: while a lot of improvements have been done the last 18 months

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: we also know that many of the providers sometimes,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: hindi na nila ginagamit yung PhilHealth to enroll kung ano yung condition ng patient.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, ma-EFIP na lang gagamitin nila kasi mas mahirap yung proseso.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, yun din naman po yung commitment namin to make it easier for healthcare providers

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: to be part of the benefit packages that we have

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: and also to make our frontline services for them much easier.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos, may mga kalukuhan na naman sa YACAP eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Yung mga LGUs, kasi sabi niyo nga minsan na-e-enroll yung mga tao na hindi nga nila alam eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos, nagagamit yung pondo na intended for them na hindi nila alam eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: So, ano po yung safeguards natin dito?

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, definitely, sir, we will be coming up with our parang YACAP 2.0 enhanced policies

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: and that's a result of all the consultations and all the feedback that's coming from the ground.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: part of this would include really institutionalizing yung liveness check,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: meaning may verification na yung patient, biometrics,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: para po malaman na yun yung actual patient.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Second is, mas malalaman nung member kung ginamit ba siya.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, ngayon po, makikita nyo sa EGOV app na may YACAP provider na kayo, etc.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Nalalagay po dyan kung may claim kayo sa inpatient.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, ito nga din po namin kung yung provider ay nag-claim on your behalf dahil YACAP mo sila.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, kung hindi mo pala alam, then actually malalaman din ng pasyente, no?

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, many other similar mechanisms will be put in place as well as CAP

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: in terms of ano lang yung kaya ng isang provider na alagaan.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So, kunwari po ngayon, medyo may default tayo, everything can go through the LGU.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: But as we move forward, we want to be able to discuss with each province, citywide health system

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: and say, ngayon po ang kapasidad po ng probinsya ninyo ay alagaan sa 300,000 of the 500,000 constituents.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Ano pong gagawin natin dun sa 200,000 remaining?

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Tate po, pilitin natin sa lahat ng health center nyo pa rin sila ma-assign.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Pero kung hindi po sila ma-accommodate, unfair naman yun sa pasyente.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So we want to work with the LGUs, not to force them to become healthcare providers

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: but to get them to be the conveners of the providers in their locality.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: And say, itong 200,000 na ito, meron bang private non-for-profit na pwedeng tumulong sa kanila

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: to operate certain yakap centers in the interim and maybe in two years time

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: with Human Resource Support, kaya na ni LGU yun, babalik na po yung mga pasyente nun kay LGU.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So para lang din po fair sa pasyente na where PhilHealth is paying for their services,

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: they should get the right services po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Meron po kami na reklamo dati na mayor sa amin kasi dun sa PhilHealth program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: ang ginawa niya, he gathered a lot of people dun sa hospital niya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: tapos pinakain, pinabaunan, pinapirma, tuwan-tuwan yung mga tao,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Pag uwi nila, yung PhilHealth pala nila, ano na, sagad na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos, ang problema ko lang po sa PhilHealth, hindi naman nila hinabol yung mayor ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: So ngayon, mukhang sa AKAP, mukhang yun din ang mangyayari eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: So I hope yung grievance mechanism natin is designed in such a way na

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: hahabulin talaga natin yung mga taong umaabuso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi ang sama ng logo sa PhilHealth eh, kasi kaya nga nakabalik na mayor yun ngayon

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Yung hospital niya, head ng hospital niya, pinanagot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Pero yung pinaka-utak nung ginawa, eh hindi naman pinanagot.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: Spirit and individual, dun po sila lahat.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
segments.text: So we have to do it well because that will be the entry point for Filipinos and to the health system po.

segments.speaker: PhilHealth President and CEO Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho
Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: I'd like to understand more yung programa ng AKAP po

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: and why ito yung parang, kinasabi niyong base program natin para ma-integrate lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Because if there is anything we can do to legislate for that, please, please tell us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi we are desperate to find a way na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: para makaawa yung mga constituents natin for medical assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos parang nakakawala ng dignidad kasi yung kailangan pang magmakaawa para matulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Sana po magtulungan tayo para at par naman tayo sa ibang mga bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi pinagtatawa naman tayo minsan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: May nakausap po two weeks ago sa lihan kong conference.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Sabi nila, bakit ka pa may medical assistance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kasi ako mismo parang hindi ko maintindihan yung healthcare system natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Ang last ko po is, sana i-remind natin yung mga hospitals na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: di ba dapat ang first contact ng mga pasyente is yung medical social worker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: May mga hospitals na hindi yung medical social worker yung unang nakakausap nila eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kaya prone tuloy sa mga abuses ng mga kalukohan minsan ng doctors or ng mga hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Okay, please wind up, Congressman Amatong.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yes po eh, kasi kailangan nga merong skills to assess yung capability or yung social status ng ating pasyente.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi nga po doon sa pag-seset nga po ng rules ng ano naman po, MIFIP, pinag-usapan na po namin, may iba pong hospital na may classification ABCDE, depende po doon sa social class, yung dami po nung pwedeng ibigay ng MIFIP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ano po namin yan, i-institutionalize po namin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At dapat po yung talagang trained na mga social worker or at least po merong certification ang pwedeng magbigay ng assessment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Since may time ba po, ang last issue ko po, ang DOH minsan, mga regional offices nyo, pag nagre-reklamo kami tungkol sa bad practices ng mga hospitals,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: lagi nilang sinasabing na wala silang position na sawayin yung mga hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Sana naman po, meron din kayong ano na pwedeng yung sitahin yung mga hospitals who are not doing well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Because, so umpisa pa lang, if they're not doing well, mas mabuti nang masita natin para masolve natin kaagad.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sige po, actually po, meron kaming corporate action center sa PhilHealth na yun po yung pinagdudulugan ng mga reklamo at meron na po po kaming sistema ngayon pa paano po i-triage, kumbaga.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mag-uusap po kami na gamitin din po yung platform na yun for hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. Maraming salamat din po sa tulong nyo sa Liloid General Hospital. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And, Secretary, may hotline po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: May hotline po yung inyong central response center para mayaman po ng lahat kung may mga complaint?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, any complaints sa hospitals, public and private, pwede tumawag sa 1555.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero yun nga po, parang meron lang po kaming ilang mga seats.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: I-professionalize na isa talagang call center, kahit third party yung mag-engage, na nabibigyan kami ng datos po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya nag-uusap na po kami pa paano pag-isahin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: On November 7 last year, this representation took the floor to deliver a privileged speech on the WHO's Global Tuberculosis Report for 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: The report confronted us with the undeniable truth that we have consistently ranked fifth in the world in terms of TB ranking, third in 2025, third.

segments.text: Yung anti-TB drugs nga po, at saka yung cartridges para dun sa gene experts.

segments.text: Kaya nung nire-constitute nga namin yung back, medyo binigyan ko ng directive to really push.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Simultaneously po, nag-reach out kami dun sa mga ating mga foreign grant na pwedeng magbigay muna habang inaayos namin itong procurement.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: In fact, the Global Fund already committed to give us substantially, almost $159 million worth of medicines for TB, HIV, and malaria.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Bulk of it will be in TB.
