segments.text: Para hindi na rin maubos ang oras.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Dahil hindi na po nagtatanong si Rep. Tino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Please restore the time of Rep. Tino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, sulat na lang po para mas comprehensive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could we just briefly hear kung bakit.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Sir, yung mga unfilled positions po would be for various reasons.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Number one po, may mga positions na there are no takers.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Especially those medical positions which would have more competitive salaries elsewhere.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Number two, yung mga may ibang hospitals po na yung ibang positions are really for residencies and fellowships.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: That's why they are not filled up permanently because these are temporary in nature.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Yung ibang mga reasons for unfilled.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano yung mga position na hindi competitive kaya hindi na-fill up?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Maylene M. Beltran
segments.text: Sir, mga physical therapies, development, speech therapies, etc. po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, isama na po yun sa isasubmit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano yung mga nature at anong problema?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, dapat i-address and so on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Pakitulat na lang po yung comprehensive answer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, again, alam natin napakalala ng problema ng sitwasyon sa mga public hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: They have to make do with limited budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, nagtataka tayo bakit in many DOH hospitals, binawasan pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In some cases, napakalaki ng binawas sa kanilang MOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Again, Irino Memorial Medical Center, binawasan ng half a billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung kanilang MOE, isang example lang yun, National Center for Mental Health, 311 million cut in MOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Habang merong policy ng zero balance billing, libre, babawasan naman yung MOE.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ito po ay sa DOH Regional Hospitals, bukod pa po itong specialty hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Dito po sa ating mga regional hospitals, ang aming GAA noong 2026 ay 101.7, ang NEPO ay 102.9.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, yun po ay for regional hospitals ng DOH ay tumaas po ng 1.1%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero yung operations of DOH hospitals in Metro Manila, yun po yung bumaba from 30 billion noong 2026 GAA to 26.9 billion,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ah, anong reason? Yung, although ang hiningi po namin ay 31.7 po para nga po to cover our projected MOOE, pero nag-grant lang po ay 26.9.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, bakit nga po, nakita ko, Batanes Provincial General Hospital, ang chairman ng health, galing sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Batanes, binawasan din ang MOE. So, wala kayong explanation. Is it a DBM matter? Then, Chair, can we ask the DBM, yung representative dito ng DBM, bakit binawasan yung MOE ng mga ospital na ito? E gipit na gipit na nga. Is the representative of DBM present? May taga-DBM po ba na nandito ngayon? Ayun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Quick interjection, Mr. Chair, if the honorable, my very good friend, Hon. Tinio will allow.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Yes, thank you very much, Mr. Chair. In relation to the question of the Honorable Tinio, may I also propose that the Department of Health furnish the Committee on Appropriations a copy of the field health reimbursements of each hospital, as well as medical assistance program allocation of each hospital, including the actual utilization of their MOOE because this might be the reason

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: why there was a cut in their MOOE because there was a higher allocation of MAIFIP as well as PhilHealth reimbursements. I so move, Mr. Chair. And thank you very much, Congressman Tolosa.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Sorry, Mr. Chair. Congressman Tinio, my very good friend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I believe that was a motion, DS. Yes. Are there any seconds?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sige. Okay. Pero gusto pa rin po natin marinig, ano yung justification for cutting the MOOE of these DOH hospitals?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So the documents are requested to be submitted para makita rin po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala po ba yung DBM dito? Ah, nandiyan na ba? Alam ko meron.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ayan, katabi niyo. Ah, please reply to the question of Congressman Tinio.

segments.speaker: DBM Official
segments.text: Yes po, good morning po, Mr. Chair, Your Honor. Ah, actually po yung

segments.speaker: DBM Official
segments.text: MOE naman po ng hospitals for DOH, we just follow naman po yung normative financing as provided din naman po by the DOH. And sila rin po yung nagbe-break ng MOE requirements. So, there may have, meron pong mga nag-decrease nga po from the 2026. But this is based naman po sa normative financing. And additionally, as mentioned nga din po ni Secretary kanina, a portion po, meron

segments.speaker: DBM Official
segments.text: pong portion na nailagay sa PhilHealth to implement the CBB, implementation of the CBB, which will eventually rin naman po is papasok din sa mga, as additional MOE po ng mga hospitals. So, yun po yung naging policy for the 2027 budget na ang tingin po kasi is sectoral nga po yung tingin natin ngayon, not just yung sa DOH lang, kasama po yung sa PhilHealth dahil nga po mayroon nga po doon na dagdag na around 14 billion to implement din po yung CBB po ng DOH. Thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could we have a response from the DOH Secretary on that? Parang nagtuturuan. Una, sabi nila, well, binatay lang namin sa sinubmit niyo. Pangalawa, the other one is binawasan yung MOE dahil mababawi naman sa PhilHealth through the ZBB, zero balance billing. Could we have a response?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, all the OH hospitals are allowed income retention.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, as mentioned earlier by Kong Garin, we should look at it in totality.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung makano po yung iba pang revenue from PhilHealth from Ma'a-Ethip.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi nga po, ang understanding ko nung kami po ay nag-usap ni Sec. Kim,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ma-iwasan po din yung tinatawag na double financing.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Meron na po tayong coverage through GAA, pero meron pa rin revenue stream from other sources.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya po, gaya po na nasabi ng ating representative from DBM,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: it's a sector approach na parang in a way itong kabuan,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: pero parang it's a left-pocket, right-pocket transaction as it pertains to PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Baka yun po yung kailangang kuntingnan din at bibigay po nga po namin yung ating datos dito po as requested po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, hindi po ba problema to na binabawasan na yung MOE?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Anyway, ang sabi nyo, mababawi naman sa Ma'a-Ethip or sa PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung mga reimbursement, buti kong instantaneous ang reimbursement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, we'll have to operate based on the available funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: E di wala silang kapos ang pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is that a fair characterization of the situation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is that fair to yung mga pasyente, mga kababayan natin?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Medyo nga po may impact in terms of the cash flow.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero ang ating nga pong next step,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: progress po tayo doon sa tinatawag na global payment.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung saan po naka-estimate na magkano po yung mga services na i-re-render po ng ating hospital.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ifo, front load na po ng PhilHealth yun sa ating mga hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang kailangan, yung pera, direct ang nasa hospital para direct ang mabigay yung servisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Usually, anong sinasabi ng mga hospital?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sorry, wala kami yan. Bumili kayo sa labas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O, dahil kulang ang budget nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, chair, again, at tinututulan po natin yung ganitong kalakaran na mukhang pinagkakasunduan ng DBM at DOH ngayon na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: dahil meron naman daw MyFIP, meron namang PhilHealth, bawasan na natin yung MOOE ng mga hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kailangan po, tiyaki, nandyan ready ang pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I mean, malinaw po na kulang ang ating capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: You mentioned DOH hospitals have, was it 23,000 total bed capacity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero, ang karanasan ng mga kababayan natin, talagang punong-puno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Lalo pa, pag may mga surge during leptospirosis or dengue and so on, punong-puno ang mga hospital, ang mga ward.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ang ginagawa nyo at nasaan sa budget na ito, yung programa para sa expansion of bed capacity ng mga DOH hospitals?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano yung achievement ng administrasyong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How many beds have been added to the DOH hospitals by this administration?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For the proposed year, next year, ilan ang dadagdag pa na bed capacity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At, meron ba tayong plano in the first place para dito?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung akin pong immediate na pwedeng gawin, kasi may lead time din po yung construction, is really efficiencies.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ngayon, ang nasabi ko, kung ma-reduce po natin yung average length of stay, dahil mas maganda po yung treatment,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ay in effect, kung ano po yung reduction dun sa tagal.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung ano po na tumatagal yung ating pasyente sa hospital, ay parang katumbas na rin ang karagdagang beds po yun.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero, ang isa pa rin po namin ginagawa sa tulong po ng PhilHealth, ay magkaroon din po ng parang inter-referral system.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yun naman po yung nakasaad dito sa ating UHC law, kung saan din po magtatap na tayo dun sa local government unit hospitals at saka mga private hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, meron na po tayong talagang tinatakda na number of beds.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ng hospital na nag-land 10% of their beds.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Na pagka meron pong apaw dito sa ating, in spite of all the efficiencies, ay pwede rin na po natin gamitin yung mga NBB beds na mga private hospital.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Although, yun po ay mga short, ang matagalan po talaga, i-expand po yung actual physical plant ng mga DOH hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Although, in short, Mr. Chair, ang intindi ko lang sa sagot ay walang plano ang DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa kagyat, and maybe until the end of the administration, walang sistematikong plano para ma-expand yung bed capacity ng mga DOH hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun ang dinig ko. Sabi, must focus on efficiencies and maybe distribute to the local hospitals and so on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, well, we will take this up further. Tingin natin may problema yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Maganda, merong zero balance billing program, pero kung limitado ang kapasidad, ay limitado ang makikinabang na mamamayan natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: at inevitably, ipapasa sila sa private sector na mas mahal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Follow up ko na lang po, please submit a report on this administration's achievements in expanding capacity and any plans, kung meron man,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: With that regard, thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Can I do that, Mr. Jointer?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nakuha ko na po yung datos.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang amin pong estimate, yung kasalukuyan pong bed capacity ay 30,000, ay aakyat po ng 45,000 by 2028.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, meron naman pong program. Isasama na lang po namin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Current po na authorized bed capacity po, ngayon, noong 2025 na 30,000, ay aakyat po ng 45,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, in two years, ay dadagdagan niyo by 15,000 yung bed capacity ng mga DOH hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Please clarify, sir, para mas maintindihan po ng committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At parang reflected ba sa budget yan? You have only until 27-28.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Naka-reflect naman po dun sa budget ng expansion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At yun nga lang po, dahil nag-cut dun sa HVEP, medyo maka-ma-delay ng konti dito sa target.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Unless nga po ma-reinstate natin yung ating pong hinihingi ng allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Tin-report na lang, Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, sek, paki yung comprehensive answer sa mga questions ni DML Tino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At yung motion ni DS Garibaldi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Pa rin, pakisagot po in written form para mas ma-appreciate ng committee and its members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Nang sa ganun, ay mas mapaliwanag natin ng mas maigi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And I understand yung efficiencies na sinasabi siguro ni Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yung bylaw, kailangan pati yung private hospital mag-create ng 10% ward.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kung magagawa ito, that will expand the bed capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Not only of the government hospital, pero magagamit natin yung existing facilities din ng private hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, malaking bagay yung paki-explain din po sa inyong written answers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, thank you very much, DML Tino, for your questions and queries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Rest assured, ipapasa po natin yung mga sagot ng DOH and PhilHealth sa committee at sa inyo po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Next, we go back to the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: May we call on our Deputy Speaker, Ferge Biron, for his questions.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: First of all, let me congratulate Secretary Mercado and Dr. Ho for your respective appointments.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, while I was observing the interpellation of Congressman Tino,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: I observed that the good Secretary,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: he has some difficulty struggling on issues pertaining to the budget of the DOH.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: May I know from the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: if this budget is your own doing or is a budget formulated by your predecessor?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: When I came, Mr. Chairman, I came in po na meron na pong approval yung NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, it's already, kumbaga, the budget from, yes.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Yes, very obvious naman siya eh, na hindi niyo budget ito eh.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, I would suggest, this representation would like to suggest to the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: you have to be honest and candid to Congress.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Kung meron kang nakita na hindi mo gusto,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: or gusto mo i-amendahan, or gusto mo dagdagan,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: sabihin mo sa amin, because we're here to help you and help the Department.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, my first question, Mr. Secretary, is,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: the bed-to-patient ratio in the hospital for both government and private hospital is 0.8

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Meaning to say, we have a deficit of around 140,000 beds.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, may I know from the Secretary, what is the present bed-to-patient ratio?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, yun po ay almost compliant to the WHO standard of 3.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Overall, nationwide, dahil nga po mas konti yung bed-to-patient ratio sa ating probinsya,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, we're still much under the prescribed bed-to-patient ratio provided by WHO.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: I'm sure you're aware that the global benchmark for national expenditure on health is 10% of GDP.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yes po, yun po yung standard benchmark.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: But for developing economies like the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, given your budget of P353 billion,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Although, when you consider po yung percentage of GDP,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: it's a combination po of government and private spending.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, government right now accounts for 46% of the total healthcare spend.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, times 2 po, baka abot na po ng 7% kung kasama po yung spending ng mga...

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, aabot tayo ng 7% of GDP.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, given the scarce resources of the government,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: your department is beset with a serious problem on expired medicines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Maliit na nga yung ating budget, maliit ang pera natin.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Pero marami pa rin ang problema ng DOH sa expired medicines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Can you provide this committee with a report of expired medicines since 2022?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: We will provide po the data, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kung year on year po, starting 2022.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Okay. So, Mr. Chair, I would like to request the DOH to furnish this committee and this representation a copy of those reports.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: But while waiting for those reports, may I know from the good secretary, what are the reasons, where do you attribute...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Kasi, this accounts for hundreds of millions since 2022.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Ang tanong is, is it attributed to poor procurement planning, inventory management control?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Where do you think is the problem?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: From my initial analysis po, given the three weeks that I was on the job,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: wala hong automated na talagang supply chain system.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: That already tracks stock level down to the level of the CHDs.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: It's all pen and paper, which we need to really improve on.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: But the other thing that we're looking at, given nga po na PhilHealth is expanding its coverage of gamot,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: some of the commodities can also be procured through the gamot program of PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Para rin wala pong double financing.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: You mean to say, Mr. Secretary, hanggang ngayon walang operating software?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Meron pong LMEIS, ito po ay donated, pero hindi po ganong kaganda ang feedback po sa atin.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, all of these medicines procured in the central office get stocked in your central warehouse?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: At tumatagal doon at hindi na dideliver sa central, sa CHDs, regional offices.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ang ginawa nga po ng ating bagong procurement undersecretary ay naggawa po ng sistema na bago po mag-procure o mag-bid out ng bagong mga commodities,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ay inaalam po yung mga stock level doon sa iba't ibang region, kinoconsolidate.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At pagsatansya po namin ay may sapat pa, hindi po muna gagawin yung procurement.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: That's one. Number two po ay yun nga, meron tayong electronic inventory system na kailangan po natin i-upgrade.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: How much do you spend? How much does DOH spend on warehousing? What is the budget on warehousing and logistics annually, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang supply chain management including warehousing and tracking po, last year was 1.2 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And for this year, approved NEP is 1.23. May konti pong increase ng 1.8%.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: If you itemize the budget, how much goes to warehousing? How much goes to logistics?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Out of the 1.2 billion, give or take po, 250 or almost 1.4 or 1.5 is in warehousing, 15 million for electronics.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And 90 million po for operating expense.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Given this huge budget for warehousing and logistics, does it make sense that most of your national program should be downloaded to the regions?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Regionalize ninyo ang mga national program kasi nangyayari is, pinoprocure ng central, hindi naman nadideliver sa region.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: They all get stuck in the central warehouse without it being delivered to the regional offices.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Would you agree with me that it's now the time to regionalize procurement?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yes, sir. In fact, we already are regionalizing. 60% of our commodities are actually procured at the region.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: These are the more commonly available meds.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang naka-centralized lang po talaga are the high-value medicines like cancer meds and vaccine.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung nabanggit ko pong warehousing, kasama din po doon ang regions.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So the cost of warehousing includes the other regions?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Includes na po the other regions.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Well, I will have other questions, Mr. Secretary, with respect to HVEP.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: But let me move on to FDA.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: May I ask the good Director General to respond to some questions?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: DG, may problema ang FDA, no?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: It's been a problem on registrations.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: And I believe the only way to address this is to fully digitalize the FDA,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: especially the CDRR and the Medical Device Division.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Can you elaborate on the budget that you want Congress to provide you?

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: The FDA has always been complaining of the lack of personnel

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: and the influx of the very high volume of applications.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: So what the CDRR thought of doing in collaboration with our other centers

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: is to come up with a system, a digital system,

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: whereby the applications will be processed or evaluated.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: So basically, it's an end-to-end digital system, sir.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: In terms of the budget, it will require about ₱217 million.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: This is not a program, a subscription-based program, sir.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: This will be an in-house program that is really designed for CDRR,

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: also replicated by the other centers as well, sir.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: What is the total budget that you are requesting Congress to provide you?

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: The total budget just for the system, sir, is ₱217 million approximately.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: But the total MOOE that we would appeal, sir, is ₱517...

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Yeah, ₱518 is the one that will be provided by Congress.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: But what is the expected revenue from the retained income of FDA?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: ₱518 million is the one that will be provided by Congress in the GAA.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, but I'm sure that you have retained income

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: coming from the revenues generated by the agency.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: How much is the counterpart of the revenue provided by the retention of your income?

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: Based on our current record, sir,

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: we don't have access to that retained income

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: unless it's time that we are allowed to touch.

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: That we are hoping that the ₱580 million will be allowed to get from that SAGF, sir.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, one more last question, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: So, your budget that you're asking Congress is from the date 18.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Presently, you are not in the position to tap the retained income

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: unless you submit to DBM your business plan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: But we have already, the previous DG, DG Teston,

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: has already submitted the five-year development plan,

segments.speaker: FDA OIC Director General Atty. Franklin Anthony M. Tabaquin IV
segments.text: which is one of the conditions for us to be able to...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I will reserve my other questions for Phil Wealth

Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Deputy Speaker Ferge at Attorney Tabakin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And DOH is requested to submit the data requested by DS Ferge,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: especially those on the expired medicine.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if the Honorable Biron is willing,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: may I amend his motion that the list include not only expired,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: but also expiring and near-expiring medicines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Please, DOH, pakisubmit po yung expired, expiring, and near-expiring.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, that includes the entire regional offices as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And siguro working lunch na lang, if okay sa ating mga members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, for now, we recognize Assistant Minority Leader, Sarah Elago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, tungkol sa existing policies na kaugnay ng anti-hospital detention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: may we know if the DOH has the numbers regarding the unsettled promissory notes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: and the amount of collectibles from patients,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lumalaki po ba ito over the years?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if you can just provide the detailed data, unfortunately.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: If it's okay with Congresswoman Sarah, okay lang po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Now, does the department have an active monitoring of the magnitude of foreclosed or ceased collateral

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: because of these unsettled promissory notes?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hingin po natin yung detalya, pero naistatis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano natin natitiyak na kung may mga issues at concerns tungkol dito,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, as I mentioned earlier po, meron tayong parang action center, 1555.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero parang gusto nga naming palawigin,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: and together with Phil Health, really manage it professionally.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, yun po ay dinudulog doon, and then we have filled offices po to invest.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Because we also want to give due process to any complaints.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, anong ibig sabihin for this action center to be managed by DOH professionally?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, is this service outsourced?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Or paano po ang management, administration, staffing, and funding for this particular action center?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: It's internally managed po, and limited pa lang yung seats.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya nga po, my experience when I was in Phil Health, it's an outsourced service.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And we get good statistics and reports, drop calls, how many are resolved, what are the most common complaints.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And then there are escalation also on kailan iyaakyat, can it be resolved at the level of the call center agent,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: when it will be brought up to the level of the regional directors, and even all the way up to central office.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, yun po yung ating pag-aaral.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kunin natin yung detalye ng mga naitawag na ilapit ng mga concerns dito sa action center.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung ano yung nature ng mga concerns ng mga tumatawag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Natanong ko rin ito dahil maraming ospital, lalo na sa private hospitals na sapin-sapin ang dinaranas na pananamantala at hinagpis ng mga pasyente

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil sa mga kondisyon sa pagbabayad ng kanilang balanse sa hospital bills.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At tulad ng pasyente, paano po kung walang pwedeng maikolateral na lupa o bahay yung mga pasyente, saan po sila maaaring lumapit sa ganitong mga kondisyon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pinapayagan ba ng DOH itong pagpapataw ng mga pagkataas-taas po na compound interest rate sa mga kolateral?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung compounding po, wala pa pong policy.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero yung pong physical detention, yun po yung maliitong set rules.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi parang commercial terms po yun that is entered into between the patient and the hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sir Chair, may batas din po tayo na anti-hospital detention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kinakailangan talaga ma-review na yung implementation na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Because while it is true that RA 9439 allows these kinds of arrangements, it is an injustice to let things remain the same.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa halit po nabalansihin yung interest ng tubo sa mga ospital at na mga pasyente,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang dapat po natin makonsidera ay ang paglalaan ng higit pang pondo sa mga pampublikong ospital

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na sa gayon maging sapat ang mga facilities, ang kanilang bed capacity,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa mas marami nating mga nangangailangan ng mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nagiging problema din po ito pag privatize talaga yung healthcare in general,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: wherein we hide under the cloak of balancing interest while profiteering from supposed social services are actually left unchecked.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaugnay nito, Mr. Chair, lahat po ng mga lumapit din sa atin ng mga kaso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kaugnay nito ay isusumitin natin sa DOH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sunod naman po, nais kong magtanong,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ang aditong nakalaan para sa Family Planning and Reproductive Health ay P664 million for 2020-7.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kaugnay nito, pwedeng makuha natin yung breakdown nitong P9.1 billion para sa Family Health, Immunization, Nutrition, and Responsible Parenting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nabanggit na po yung para sa RH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nabanggit na po yung ibang sub-programs sa ilalim nito.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: There's a list po on commodities, on women and children's protection, on safe motherhood,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: on adolescent health program, on family planning program support.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: We can give po the breakdown.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ahingin po natin yung detalye ng proposal, kaugnay nyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating naman sa women and children protection units,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At may plano ba na magsagawa, mag-establish pa ng mas marami nito sa buong bansa?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So, meron po tayong nakalaan na P51 million for women and children's protection support to women and children's protection unit in P51 hospitals po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa P51 hospitals, may plano po tayo for next year na funding for establishment of new ones?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sir, is inclusive already of the expansion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I just, I'm asking how much is the current number?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: rin ba sa P51M yung pagpupondo sa development at distribution ng Sexual Assault Investigation Kit na sariling gawa po ng mga Pilipino, yan ho ay isa sa mga tagumpay ng mga DOST-backed projects natin para magkaroon ng science-backed support services para sa access to justice ng mga nabibiktima ng abuso.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung P51M po ay kasama na yung kits although medyo we need data nga to see if it is sufficient kasi nga baka dun pa lang sa support ng program.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: We will provide po makano po yung actual breakdown po nitong P51M for Women and Child Protection to include po kung makano yung kits.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At the other ones are to support the operation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung kits po ay kukunin natin yung na-develop ng DOST. O meron po kayong ibang source?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Hindi pa po explicit Mr. Chair na yung DOST-developed kits ang ginagamit but we will review po kasi we can incorporate that in our TOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. Napaka-ganda ko nung dinevelop mismo ng atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At yung mga siyentistang Pilipino at dapat yung DOH yung manguna sa paggamit nito sa mga WCPUs natin sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil yan ho ang dilema ngayon ng DOST, meron ho tayong magandang na-develop na saikit pero ang DOH po sa ngayon ay wala pa ho malinaw na plano para mag-procure ng diretsyo at tumulong sa distribution nito para ho sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Chair, tungkol sa Cancer Assistance Fund, lumaki ho ito ng lubusan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron po tayong House Resolution para tignan kung paano na ba ang implementation ngayon ng ating National Integrated Cancer Control Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At isa po sa mga pinakalalapit na concerns sa representasyon na ito ay yung kulang na suporta para sa post-treatment, aftercare, survivorship benefits and other support services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ngayon po ba ang PhilHealth ba na expanded?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ngayon po ba yung package natin para sa cancer care mas malawak po yung ating masasagot na mga serbisyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ngayon din sa DOH, kasama na po ba dito sa pagtaas ng ating Cancer Assistance Fund, lahat po ng care-related components na kailangan ng ating mga pasyente at lahat po ng ating mga cancer warriors at survivors?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: For the Cancer Fund nga po, meron kaming minumungkahing mga amendments to include po and expand the coverage including blood products, even the nutritional support.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi yung initial po medyo limited lang to medicine. So kaya po this year, tumaas po yung ating Cancer Fund ng almost 25.6% to account all those additional support po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay. To end, Mr. Chair, I'd just like to put on record a request for the DOH to submit to this committee its report on its gender and development mandate compliance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: That's one. Number two po yung tungkol sa pagpapatupad natin ng National HIV Policy Act sa RH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Gayon din po sa programa natin para sa National Integrated Cancer Control Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I'm Assistant Minority Leader, Sarah Ilago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And DOH is requested to submit said documents to the committee para ma-share po natin sa ating mga membro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: If I may, Chair, also the anti-detention data po, nirequested po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So now we go back to the majority.

segments.text: We now recognize Vice Chair Rufus Rodriguez for his questions.

segments.text: Again, President, good afternoon to our Secretary of the Department of Health, Edwin Mercado, and to the Field Health President, Beverly Ho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: First of all, the City of Cali, and your thanks to our Secretary for approving, together with the Rector Tan Langit, approving already the FLR that we have.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And I'd like to recognize also here your very outstanding Regional Director.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Can you focus to that beautiful, that handsome man there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we have only, we have 60 million only for this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we are very thankful together with the work of our Regional Director.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And with the Secretary approving it, it will be downloaded in October.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Is he a director or a director?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And with that, we are sure that we are able to have our Rural Health Centers be given a renovation and expansion.

segments.text: And then, of course, the equipment is a part of the 60.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: But once we renovate the equipment, you have also approved the downloading of the FLR for the equipment that's handled by RD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Now, my question, Mr. Chairman, is how much budget did you propose to the DBM and how much was given?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: In other words, how much was cut?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the total that we requested was 837 billion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: A difference of 485 po ang nabawas doon sa amin pong initial request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez

segments.text: This was not during your time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: It was during the time of Secretary Ted Erbosa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Actually, ang unang hiningi ko, inyong moko-call vaccine.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pero nung binigay ko na yung sulat ay, sabi niya, wala pala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, sabi ko, okay lang yung flu vaccine para sa mga seniors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: When we requested, sabi niya, wala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Then, apparently, there was no bidding for moko-call and flu vaccine.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But that was several months ago already.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Madam Chair, yun nga po yung na-mention namin na the BAC already recommended the award.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At kami po ay on track to procure at most probably by...

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: October po or early November po ay meron na po tayong ma-i-de-distribute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Yung question ko, why was there a belated award?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Parang yung problema sa age prep rin natin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because either nahuhuli yung pagtapos, nahuhuli yung award.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But now, what happened in this particular instance?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pwede pong tawagin natin si Yusek Lel sa kilabon po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Siya po yung aming Yusek for procurement po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Cong Bong, that's the last question and then we'll...

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: Number one, there was a protest by one of the disqualified bidders.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: And then, it was coincided with the change in management.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: So, it was endorsed to the predecessor of the acting secretary right now,

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: And then, of course, he only remained with the DOH for, I think, two weeks.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: So, and he was not able to resolve it because he's supposed to review the protest.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: And then, acting Secretary Mercado already resolved the protest.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: For the 2026, there's already a noticeable word also with 2025, sir.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: That is the one that has the protest, sir.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: But we already resolved, sir, that particular issue, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because of the protest, because of change in management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Actually, yung protest, it depends on anong reason yung protest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because during a bidding process, napakadaling magdating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But I would not dwell on that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kasi ang importante lang sa akin yung mga gamot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But the thing is, we all know.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Yung change in management should not be a cause.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because hindi naman buong DOH ang pinapalitan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, ibig mong sabihin, every time that there is a change in the secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: all the procurement process will stop?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ganun ba yung kalakaran sa DOH?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: But, of course, the incoming secretary would have to do his due diligence regarding the matter.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: He has his own legal team to review the recommendations of the COVAX, sir.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, to the detriment of the beneficiaries, the patients, the Filipino people who would need those vaccines?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: But we, on our side, the procurement side and the legal service, we provide briefers.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: But, just the same, there has to be an independent evaluation by the Secretary of Health

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: in whether he agrees with the recommendation of the COVAX, sir.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Christian Lel M. Saquilabon
segments.text: But, certainly, sir, moving forward, we'll abbreviate the process regarding procurement, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The reason why there is a government structure, parang whether private yan o government office yan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So that, in case na may mawala, may mag-resign, may natanggal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: the company or the government would still be able to move.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kasi, kagaya, if I rely on yung sinabi mo as a basis, kaya hindi nag-procure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: That should have been given at the start of the year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: By the time magkaroon ng bidding kayo at magkaroon ng award,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: baka nobyembre na yan, iro-roll out nyo pa sa mga regions yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kaya, kailan pa darating sa beneficiary?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: What steps are we, will we take to fix this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Dahil, as I will go back, this is healthcare.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Madam Chair, moving forward nga po, we directed already to have an early procurement process po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya, for 2027, since the NEP is already approved,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Para hindi na po mangyari ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you very much for the time provided.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Suntay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Representative Emano, we will go back to your 3 minutes 33 seconds time left.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: If you will allow, since our Regional Director is not able to come to the room,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: I think USEC Maestral would be able to answer your queries.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: So, maybe, Kong Bambi, you could restate your question so that we can answer properly.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, di ba kanya yung oras 6.33 yung natira?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, who chose the location for the hospital, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Sir, I'm sorry the regional director is indisposed right now.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: But the engineer of the region is here.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: I cannot hear, Madam Chair, please.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: If she can speak closer to the...

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Okay. Apparently, the land was donated by the local government during that time.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: And then when it was passed, the project was executed by the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: We'll get there, Madam Chair. We'll get there.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: So who chose the specific location where the hospital will be placed, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: The land was donated po. So it was pre-chosen.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Okay. Let me continue, Madam Chair, if you will allow.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: May I know the status of the hospital?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The status of the hospital now, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: And may we know, Madam Chair, how many phases will it be to be finished?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Because 98% is actually too big, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: The second phase is almost done.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: And may we know the design, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: How many floors will it be?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: It was adjusted to three stories due to issues with budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, I don't think it's because of the issue of the budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: May we know the real issue, why it could not be five stories, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Okay. In 2025, it was discovered that it sits on a fault line, po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: And it sits on a fault line.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: So, again, Madam Chair, let me go back to my first question.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Who decided where the hospital will be placed, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: po, when they donated the land.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I know, what was the technical evaluation submitted by, for the record, DPWH, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Okay. Initially, there was no report of a fault line in the area, sir.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: And it was only discovered, I believe, in 2025.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: But with regards to the report, we will need time to secure the report, po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, again, beg to disagree.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Fault lines are from time immemorial.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: It was not just discovered last 2025 that it existed, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: They discovered, daw po, na may, that it sits on a fault line in 2025 lang.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Oh, no, Madam Chair. I cannot accept that answer.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: It cannot, you know, fault line that does not just exist, Madam Chair, all of a sudden.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Okay. Initially, po, sa hazard map, it says it's...

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: And when the hazard map was updated, malapit na malapit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: I still don't agree, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Can I see the hazard map that they're talking about when was it established, given, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: We will submit na lang, po, because it's not with the technical team right now.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Will it be submitted before plenary, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Okay. That would be a very fine answer, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: So, is it still possible to build a five-story building, Madam Chair, in a fault line?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: A hospital in a fault line, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Sir, they decided na three floors na lang.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: And then, it needs to be...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: I think the word is retrofitted, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: And DOH can guarantee that once it is retropated, built a three-story building, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: it is now safe to use for public, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: That is the expertise of DPWH, po.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: Yun po ang purview from the DPWH side.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: I-retrofit lang daw po and okay naman.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: So, I'll take the word of DOH for it, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Pag munay nangyari doon, at least on record,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: DOH allowed it to be built.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Maybe we request the DOH Regional Director and USEC through Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: to determine and how to assess this project.

segments.text: because when we do infrastructure projects,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: So, may we request DOH to review the process,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: the procedures on determination of site up to the suitability of the site and submit to DS Bambi before the plenary budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Yeah, it would be very fine, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: For the record, Madam Chair, if ever DPWH allows them to build with all the other agencies allowing them to build,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: may we know what the plan is now, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: A three-story level-what hospital, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: We will review first the report from the DP, Sir.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: And then, we will give you a copy and our decision.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Mary Ann Palermo-Maestral
segments.text: I will need to see it for myself as well.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Madam Chair, I was given already a...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: I was able to assist during the consultation and I was expecting already answers.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Would the Chair guarantee that during the plenary that I'll be able to ask DOH about this, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Secretary, will we be able to provide DS Bambi prior to plenary so that we can address all the issues prior to plenary?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: So, DS Bambi, you have the commitment of DOH.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Maybe allow me, Madam Chair, to ask DOH during DOH's time in the plenary, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: If that's a guarantee that the good Chair has given, the beautiful Chair has given us,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: I will continue my questions and hopefully there will be answers during the plenary, Madam Chair.

Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano

segments.text: The next on deck is Representative Marlesa Hofer-Hasim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Good afternoon, President Ho and the DOH team.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Nasagot na lahat ng katanungan ko kaninang umaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Pero I would just like to ask DOH about the current state of medical education in our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: I know that this issue may be best answered by CHED,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: but I believe DOH should be active.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: I believe DOH should be actively involved in this issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Question number one, how many medical schools do we currently have nationwide, private and public?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Approximately, how many new physicians do we produce each year?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: How many new licensed physicians are absorbed by the DTTB program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: How many physicians remain in practice in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: And how many eventually leave the country to practice abroad?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Is the medical doctors' diaspora still a significant concern for our country?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: And do we have current data on the number of Filipino physicians working overseas

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: compared with those practicing here in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: We have big plans, but we need healthcare providers to be on the ground and implement all these plans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: I believe these figures are important in understanding whether we are producing enough doctors

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: for the needs of our population, particularly in undeserved and geographic areas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlesa "Doc Marly" Hofer-Hasim
segments.text: Thank you and I look forward to hearing your insights.

segments.text: While Director Joe Banson is pulling up the data,

segments.text: I can answer the estimated number of medical schools.

segments.text: 48 in Luzon, 19 in the Visayas, and 15 in Mindanao.
