segments.text: Sinasabi po sa kanila, pagka hindi nila ma-cover yung billing, maghanap kayo ng congressman, maghanap kayo ng senador.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Eh kayo naman po ang may hawak kasi nung MAIP. So bakit hindi na lang yung one-stop shop nga, o kayo na lang mag-coordinate kung kanino puwedeng humingi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang nangyayari po, para silang ano eh, parang bumabalik sa dati na parang they have to look for congressmen and senators para lang makahingi ng assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kawawa naman po yung pasyente, na sila na nga may sakit o kapamilya na nila may sakit, tapos maghahanap pa sila ng tagabayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So I hope we can strengthen the one-stop shop na wala na po silang problemahin. Isa na lang ang lalapitan nila and everything will be facilitated for them. Is that possible?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Madam Chair, yun nga po yung contracting engagement na nais naming pasukin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Combined with PhilHealth na pag nag-shift to global payment, yung mga outliers na hindi ordinarily na kukover ng PhilHealth, automatic may moa din po to cover yung maipip.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Tapos yung others na po na supposedly with PhilHealth and maipip, siguro substantially.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sek, pwede niyo po bang ilapit?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yes po. So yun po yung part nung ano namin. Planong mag-join contract.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Contracting engagement with the hospitals. Na yung pong global payment, meron pong mga outliers na ang second layer naman ay maipip. So gagawin po namin yun ng sistema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, let me go to my next question. Paano dini-determine ng DOH po ang maipip allocation per region and hospital? May scientific formula ba based on poverty, population, disease burden, patient volume, utilization, and actual need?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: Madam Chair, the downloaded funds to the DOH hospitals, we determine the amounts based on the level of the hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can you speak up? Pakilapit na po.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: Based on the level of the hospitals and the absorptive capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ilan po ang, if that's the case, ilan po ang maipip disbursement as of today?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Your data, 61.3% po ang hindi na disperse. Or 61.3% ang actual disbursement rate ninyo for last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang hindi po natin na gastos is 41 billion. So kung may scientific basis po yan, yung 41 billion na sana na yan, sana nagamit na natin sa zero balance billing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang dami pa rin hong, di ba, yung sinasabi ko kanina na yung ating out-of-pocket is around 44%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Na sana yung maipip na lang ho ang tumulong.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: The 50% obligation rate is actually the combined CONAP and GAA.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: And the 50% and the disbursement rate is 70%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sorry. Can you please speak into the mic?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: Madam Chair, for year 2025, our obligation rate, updated obligation rate is actually 86%.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: So 2026 po, 50% because we're still waiting for the cash.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Paano po kaya natin masisiguro na hindi nagiging palakasan yung pag-disburse, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: For example, kami po sa bagong henerasyon, since 2025, sinabihan po kami na wala kaming maaring i-request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Na additional MyVIP allocation for hospitals, for patients referred to us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: While apparently, meron po mga ibang opisina that continue to receive allocations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ano po ang objective basis kung sino ang nabibigyan at sino ang hindi?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: As far as the MyVIP program is concerned, all referred patients are assessed by the medical social worker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sorry, ma'am. Can you please speak into the mic?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: All referred patients are assessed by the medical social worker.

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: So yun po yung aming eligibility requirement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Paano, ma'am? Can you repeat that?

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung pong kung sino nabibigyan, based on eligibility requirement,

segments.speaker: DOH Undersecretary Zhielah Ritz C. Gatchalian
segments.text: na based din po sa assessment ng medical social workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can, can, Mr. Chair, can, Madam Chair, can we request DOH to submit before plenary

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: the complete MyVIP allocations for 2024, 2025, and 2026 by region, hospital, and health facility?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Including additional downloads, augmentations, utilization, patient-served, remaining balances,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and where applicable, requesting, or referring office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Siguro, can I touch on one more?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Just a moment, Robert. So we're requesting DOH to please provide the data requested.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Under section 29, Secretary, of the Universal Healthcare Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: at least 10% of private hospital beds should be basic or wired accommodation

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Seven years na po ang batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Nangyayari, nangyayari na ba talaga ito today?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa amin pong mga exit interviews sa mga LGU at saka DOH,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa private po yung medyo mahirap po talagang i-monitor.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: But yun nga po ang ginagawa namin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nagkaka-prone na po kami ng parang contracting out.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nag-agree na kami doon sa coverage.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At mag-shift na nga po tayo to global budget once we're done with the computation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But Mr. Secretary, Madam Chair, the law is very clear.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Na dapat 10% po nung beds nila ay ina-allocate nila for no balance billing

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So bakit wala ba tayong clear guidelines to implement this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And why are we not imposing this on private hospitals?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yes, we're starting to strengthen our monitoring po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And since we already did an across the board 30 and 50,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: so it's practically 95 expansion of the Z-Bend,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: we're really intent on implementing po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So when can we expect the clear guidelines, Secretary, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Before the budget hearing ends, matatapos po natin yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And we will implement the law?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung license, pwede naman pong part yun nung licensing natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kasi nga, kaya po start of year, gagamit na po natin as reason na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So if they do not implement, di nila sinundan yung batas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Mr. Chair, Madam Chair, and Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Doon po sa mga doktor na hindi po po mapayag na tumanggap sila ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: MyVip para sa, or GL para sa kanilang, ano, sa kanilang PF,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang ginagawa natin para maayos po ito?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So for DOH and government, and LGU government po, required po talaga natanggapin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Doon po naman sa mga private, kaya nabanggit ko kanina,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: we're already coordinating with the different specialty societies.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At least the four major ones, the PCS, College of Surgeons, Obstetrics and Gynecology,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: the Philippine College of Physicians, which are the internal medicine,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: and also the pediatrician, the PPS.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So we hope to also come up.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Meron na po kaming mga proposal na pininisent.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: It could be patterned after the HMO as a multiple of the RVU, na may multiplier,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: or a percentage of what PhilHealth currently is covering.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So we're negotiating na po, or we're already coordinating and collaborating with them po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Is it case rate or mabagal ang bayad pagka ano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Bakit ho ba nagiging hesitant yung mga doktor?

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: I think it's a factor of both.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: mamarkup ako kasi cost of money, kasi matagal kayo magbayad.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Which I was able to solve in PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ngayon, with payment in 15 days, di na nila marason yun.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kaya tinitingnan nga namin na yung mga EFIP ay maging parang global payment na front-loaded,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So yun po yung ginagawa natin na sistema.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Para mas makapag-negotiate tayo at makapag-engage po ng mga doktor.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
